scope: One application ID, separately paired device keys and host-owned fixed loopback service grants

pairing.authentication: SPAKE2 confirmations bound to app ID, Noise handshake hash and both static peer keys
pairing.reconnect: Pinned host key checked before Noise message 3; connection errors never replace trust
pairing.persistence: Client pending record precedes acknowledgement; host durable commit precedes confirmed reply

framing.direct: u32 big-endian ciphertext length then ciphertext
framing.relay: One ciphertext record per binary WebSocket message

host.status.visibility: Only the requesting peer's granted services

peer.leave.commit: Durable self-revocation before acknowledgement; no target peer field

media.route: Explicit private/VPN route; native SDK derives destination from that route and uses only the authenticated offered port
media.TLS: Quinn/rustls TLS1.3, exact Noise-delivered leaf certificate hash plus provider handshake signature verification, no0RTT or resumption, fixed tether.invalid SNI
media.authorization: First reliable QUIC stream is exactly lease_id16 || token32; server replies byte1 after atomic single-use consumption and current grant check
media.ownership: RAM capability belongs to its originating authenticated Noise session; parent close, grant removal, expiry or host stop ends the lease
media.datagrams: No application fragmentation. Actual negotiated maximum is authoritative, at most1200 bytes; initial conservative offer1152 bytes
media.queues: Bounded; excess real-time packets may be rejected or dropped. API writes are never automatically replayed
media.cloud: Reliable WSS packet streams are a separate explicit API; no automatic fallback and no lossy-network latency guarantee

owner_pipe.transport: Inherited private parent stdin/stdout pipes; not a public owner socket

reply.payload: command-specific public state; pairing code only on explicit pair-code reply

owner_pipe.EOF: Ends the owned helper even when an owner command is waiting on a configuration lock

FFI.ABI: tether_call(readable_UTF8_pointer,length) returns owned UTF8 JSON C string; tether_free exactly once
FFI.response: ok boolean plus fields, or a fixed error code; neither request nor response may be logged

media_start.address: original selected route hostname or IP

FFI.media_handle: Opaque process-local uint64; caller closes after failure, cancellation or completion; never persist/reuse across processes

media_receive_wait.threading: Caller thread may wait; native wrappers use a dedicated blocking queue or thread-pool task, never the UI/cooperative executor
media_receive_wait.bounds: One waiter per handle; data, close or timeout wakes it; no global registry lock held
